description: Add text to the end of a ticket's description, after a blank line. Nothing already there is changed, including an edit someone made a moment ago, and the description is not resent. Use this to add notes, findings or a plan below what a person wrote.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: append_to_description
title: Add to a ticket's description
